snippet.title: Joy Malignant - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4608380/Joy_Malignant/

Joy Malignant is a visceral dice-driven RPG game in a cursed city of gut-wrenching suffering. Here, your past shapes your skills and your appearance. Survive the city's hellish trials, meet tortured characters, and develop your own unique indentity. Every choice matters as your actions will literally shape you.
